objective: Independently decide whether M832 closes M831 P1 by binding protected-prefix inspection and one-shot consumption to one verified results-directory FD without changing the decoder schedule.
required_attacks: Recompute every M832 member and sidecar, M833 handoff, M831 negative authority, frozen M828/M819/M809 closure, and all applicable double seals.

Reject duplicate JSON keys and non-finite constants. Run Python 3.10 and Python 3.6 compile, self-test, M832 12/12, M828 12/12, M809 9/9, M815 10/10, candidate validation, and bash -n. Do not invoke the formal runner or production modes.

Audit that parent and results directories open with O_DIRECTORY and O_NOFOLLOW; the current results child is lstat-ed relative to the pinned parent FD and its dev/inode must equal the opened results FD before and after private stage creation.

Prove prefix scans, mkdirat stage creation, exclusive openat receipt writes, and renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE attempt publication all use the same results FD. No shell path-based mkdir or mv may consume the attempt.

Independently attack directory replacement between scan samples, immediately before stage creation, and immediately after stage creation. Every attack must reject; a self-created private stage must be removed from the pinned old directory, and replacement artifacts must not be clobbered.

Create persistent protected-prefix regular files, directories, symlinks, dangling symlinks, FIFOs, Unix sockets, and concurrent injections. Every type must reject without clobber. The contract makes no historical claim for an object created and removed before the consumption boundary; do not invent one.

Attack private-stage and canonical-attempt collisions, wrong or reordered guarded prefixes, alternate results paths, and close nonmatching prefixes. Fail closed without deleting attacker-owned objects; close nonmatches must not reject a stable clean consumption.

Prove exact release preflight and the resource gate precede the sole guard-and-consume helper in the exact runner. No formal attempt, result, failure, log, production row, or external action may occur in this review.

Run the clean temporary path through exact M832, exact frozen M828, M819, and M809, stopping at M809 output.mkdir with zero rows, no output, unchanged attempt receipt, and every delegated validator restored.

Attack missing or wrong source SHA, forged M831 PASS/authorization, altered runtime/resource/headline/claim fields, wrong canonical path or attempt status, and forged future release fields. All must reject source-only.

Prove runtime remains exactly 40 M686 plus 120 M699, T10, A1/K1x8/K8, 96 lanes, 245760 B, Acc24, 3 ns, and 192 B/cycle. D1 remains charged/nonheadline and only K8 versus equal-service K1x8 may headline.

Confirm the runner is a non-executable regular source, the M832 release/attempt/result/failure paths remain absent, no production/VCS/EDA/license/GPU/remote task ran, no cycle/speedup/energy/PPA/system/Table-A/paper claim exists, and docs359 is exact.
